transfer.title: Instant bank transfer (VietQR)
transfer.hint: Scan with any banking app — the amount and transfer reference are pre-filled.
transfer.qrCaption: Open your banking app and choose Scan QR
transfer.qrFailed: The QR code could not be loaded — please transfer using the details alongside.
transfer.qrUnavailable: No QR code yet — please transfer using the details alongside.
transfer.codeHint: Enter exactly this reference so the system can match your payment automatically. A wrong or missing reference means the payment waits for manual matching.

wallet.title: E-wallet
wallet.sandboxHint: The gateway is in test mode — no real money is charged.
wallet.redirectNote: You will be taken to the wallet's page to confirm. XePrime records the payment once the wallet reports it, even if you close that page.
wallet.windowTooShort: There is too little time left to pay by e-wallet. Please transfer using the QR code now.
wallet.missingLink: The wallet did not return a payment link. Please try again.

pay.transferAuto: The system confirms automatically as soon as the money arrives — you don't need to stay on this page.

summary.title: Payment details
summary.safety: To protect your payment, only transfer using the exact details on this page.

order.loadError: Could not load the payment status.
order.awaitingTitle: Waiting for {provider} to confirm the payment of {amount}
order.awaitingBody: If you have finished paying, this page updates itself once {provider} reports the result — no need to pay again.
order.noTransactionBody: {provider} reports this attempt was not paid — you may have cancelled or not finished. Please choose a payment method below.
order.expiredBody: If your account was charged, XePrime still records it once the gateway reports back — do not pay again. If not, choose a payment method again.
order.confirmingBody: This usually takes only a few seconds. You do not need to pay again.
order.completedInvoice: The payment was recorded against invoice {code}.
order.completedHold: The payment was recorded against reservation payment {code} for this trip.
order.failedTitle: The {provider} payment did not go through
order.failedBody: Nothing has been recorded. You can try again or pay by bank transfer with the QR code. If your account was charged, contact support with code {code}.
order.duplicateRefundedTitle: Received {amount} via {provider} — this was a duplicate payment
order.duplicateRefundedBody: Booking hold {code} had already been paid in full, so XePrime has refunded this duplicate to your points wallet. You do not need to do anything.
order.needsSupportTitle: XePrime received the payment details for {amount} but could not record them automatically
order.needsSupportBody: Our support team will review it and contact you — do not pay again. Reference: {code}.

return.title: Payment result
return.missingOrder: This link does not carry a payment.

appReturn.title: Returning to the XePrime app
appReturn.detail: The payment result will show in the app. If the app does not open automatically, tap the button below.
appReturn.invalid: This app return link is not valid.
